messages:
sarah: Quick sync — we need to nail scope for the observability sprint (dashboards, traces, cost breakdown, error analytics). FintechX needs per-customer cost attribution; SocialCo asked for end-to-end trace linking to external infra. Can we list the minimums to ship an MVP by end of next sprint?

 diego: +1. My take: MVP should be 3 things: 1) Cost dashboard with per-model & per-route tags (no live per-customer yet), 2) Trace hook that attaches request_id to existing traces, sample 5% by default, 3) Basic error groups + counts, surface top-5 errors in Console.

 olivia: Agree with the scope, but note ingestion/costs: full traces at 100% will blow budget. Sampling + async ingest is required. Also recommend a retention policy: 7d for full traces, 30d for aggregated stats.

 mira: For the Console UX, a single 'Observability' screen with panels: Top routes by cost, Error spike chart, Trace search box (by request_id). We can reuse the MetricCard component to save time. Mockup ETA: 3 days.

 sarah: Good. Priorities for PM: what are the must-haves vs nice-to-haves? I'll pull customer asks into tickets.

 diego: Must-haves: cost by model/route (queryable), trace hook (request_id injection + sample), error grouping + top-5. Nice-to-have: per-customer cost, side-by-side anomaly detection, exportable CSV.

 olivia: Operational must: throttling knobs for ingestion, sampling override per-customer, ability to toggle retention. Also add an alerting rule template for sudden error rate x3 baseline -> page.

 sarah: Customers to call out in acceptance: FintechX (per-customer cost accuracy within 10%), SocialCo (can link trace to external trace id), Platform team (must be able to flip sampling for Dedicated clusters). Add these to rollout criteria.

 eng-bot: deploy-checklist: "integration-tests:observability" passed on staging at 1712350000

 diego: Tech notes: Implementation approach:
```
- Add request_id header propagation in frontend + gateway
- Emit lightweight trace envelope with span refs
- Metric pipeline: tags [model, route, customer_id?] -> aggregate counts and token-cost
```
We should wire cost calc to billing-service for consistency.

 mira: UX decision: hide customer_id in UI by default (privacy). Show a customer filter only for enterprise roles.

 sarah: Risks: cost accuracy (token attribution), ingestion cost, and privacy. Mitigations: sampling, gated enterprise features, alignment with billing-service. OK to proceed to RFC draft? :eyes: 

 diego: Yes. I'll open RFC and include perf estimates (qps * trace-size).

 olivia: I'll add SLO impact notes and storage cost projection.

 sarah: Thanks — action items: diego RFC by Tue, mira mocks by Wed, olivia SLO/cost by Thu. I'll schedule stakeholder sync Fri 10am. :calendar: 

 mira: ack :+1: 

 diego: ack 

 sarah: filing tickets now.
